name: fruugo-mcp
description: Fruugo (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped, set_inventory, end_listing. Every tool m

platform_mcp_fruugo_username.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FRUUGO_USERNAME
platform_mcp_fruugo_username.description: Fruugo Retailer Portal login (the Order and Stock Status APIs use the portal credentials with HTTP Basic).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe downloads today's released orders (GET /orders/download/v2?from=<today>) to verify the portal credentials.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Download Orders v2: `since` (ISO 8601 date or datetime) is REQUIRED and is compared with the time Fruugo RELEASED the order (after payment and fraud checks), not the order date. The API is not paged: it returns every order released since then, with order lines, statuses (PENDING, PROCESSED…) and shipments under raw; `status` is not a server-side filter.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: Ship Order for every item on the order (orderId from list_orders). `carrier` is sent as trackingUrl, which Fruugo documents as "a URL of the courier company where the package can be tracked or at a minimum the courier name"; `tracking_number` is relayed to the customer. Confirm the order first in the portal or it ships from PENDING directly.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: Stock Inventory Update: `listing_id` is the fruugoSkuId (Fruugo's numeric SKU id, listed by GET /stockstatus-api), required; itemsInStock is saved synchronously (the live site follows within minutes). The availability flag is left unchanged; use end_listing to mark a SKU NOTAVAILABLE.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Sets availability NOTAVAILABLE for one fruugoSkuId (listing_id): "The product is permanently out of stock and needs to be removed." Your product feed must stop listing it too, or the next feed import restores it.
